description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You Redline.

You promise the Widow of Rust the trouble you are about to avoid. This Redline's effect is doubled — double its duration, or its damage, or its bonus, whichever single quantity it has. In exchange, the next three times you Redline you roll for Slippage twice and take the worse result. The debt cannot be paid down, refused, or transferred; it comes due in order.

cinderfall.incomplete: [REDLINE-NO-SCHEMA] -- even though a real RollTwice rule element exists (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/roll-twice.ts) and could in principle model "roll twice, take worse" for a genuine Foundry check, "the roll that determines Slippage" is not a Foundry check at all (it's a GM-side fictional table), so there is nothing for RollTwice to attach selector to.
